note: E4b: implicit L1 time stepping of 16 fractional Bloch systems (alpha=0.6, T=10). wall_*: median/min/max of n_repeats timed solves (s); err_*: absolute maximum-norm errors against the closed-form solution (all nodes n>=1 / nodes with t>=T/64 / t=T); absdiff/reldiff_to_full_same_mesh: max|x_SOE - x_full| over all nodes (absolute / divided by max|x_full|); soe_rel_kernel_err: REALISED relative kernel error on [delta,T]; peak_heap_MB: separate untimed tracemalloc run storing only the final state; time_ratio_full_over_this: wall(full history, tabulated weights on the uniform mesh, row weights on the graded mesh) / wall(this solver) at the same N. Timing conditions: one fresh process per (solver, N); BLAS pinned to one thread; one untimed warm-up solve with min(N, warmup_N) steps; then `repeats` timed solves (`repeats_slow` if a solve takes longer than slow_threshold_s); wall time by time.perf_counter around the solver call only; tracemalloc is NOT active during timing; all nodes are stored in every run System load before/after the timing run: 6.0% / 34.0%. Columns *_run2: second complete timing run (system load before/after: 20.0% / 84.0%); wall_best_of_both_runs_s: smallest single time of both runs.
